From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Avalon discovery recap + trial kickoff plan

Hi Julie / Samir —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the agreed next steps so we have shared ownership: 

- What we covered: goal is to evaluate Redwood for inference of document summarization + privacy controls for PII redaction during inference.
- Trial scope: 2 dev seats, sandbox VPC (data-in-place), 1 model variant (open-llama-13b q4), traffic cap ~10k tokens/day.
- Success criteria (agreed): inference latency < 600ms p95 for 512 tokens, zero PII leakage in sample tests, and basic autoscaling behavior under burst.

Next steps (owners / ETA):
1) I will provision the trial environment and share onboarding links (Nikhil) — target: Nov 5.
2) Marissa to run a 45-min kickoff/hand-hold session once provisioning done (Marissa) — propose Nov 9 or 10.
3) Your team to complete the network allowlist and provide the test dataset (Julie / Samir) — target: Nov 8.

Attachments: trial checklist + network diagram (stubs attached). I also included a short Doc with runbook for running the sample evals.

If anything here looks off, flag it and I will update. Otherwise I will proceed with provisioning and send the invite for the kickoff.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Julie / Samir —

I provisioned your sandbox on Nov 5 and sent the invite to the team (you should have a provisioning email from support@redwood.ai with console links). Marissa is standing by to run the 45-min kickoff.

I can see that the environment is up but there hasn't been any inference traffic yet (no API keys called). Wanted to check: are you still on track for the allowlist / dataset? Do you want us to run the kickoff with a smaller set of participants (Samir + 1 dev) to unblock?

If there are technical blockers on your side (network, proxy rules), David can jump in to help triage. If the timing shifted and you want to postpone, tell us the new window and we'll adjust.

Options:
- Quick triage call (30 min) to fix allowlist — David available Wed 18 10:00-11:30 PT
- Full kickoff (45 min) with runbook walk-through — Marissa available Thu 19 14:00-15:00 PT
- Share the dataset and we can run a test on our side and send results for your review (no changes to your infra).

If I don't hear back, I will follow up one more time this week.

Best,
Nikhil

Subject: Signal loss — can we restart the Avalon trial or pause?

Hi Julie / Samir —

I haven't seen a reply to the last note and there's still zero usage in the sandbox. I realize priorities shift — quick check to see whether you want to:

A) Restart now — proposed times next week for either a short triage or the full kickoff (Marissa + David on calendar if you pick a slot).
B) Pause the trial — we can keep the environment, but we'll halt active monitoring and reclaim reserved capacity after 30 days unless you tell us otherwise.

We'd love to help you get unblocked so you can validate the latency and PII checks you care about. If it helps, I can loop in a solutions engineer for a hands-on session and schedule a joint run of your sample dataset so you have results by EOD that day.

Please pick A or B (or propose new dates). If neither is feasible, a quick reply with an expected month (e.g., "Jan") is totally fine — we'll re-engage then.

Thanks for the candid update — we want to be respectful of your time and cloud spend.
